context.passage:
Harper's Gym
Guest Membership
One of our valued members has invited you to Harper's Gym! As our guest, enjoy a
complimentary membership for one month. Bring this card to Harper's Gym and an
attendant at the front desk will activate your membership.
The guest membership entitles you to unlimited use of our facilities and equipment.
You can also sign up for fitness classes and personal training sessions; extra charges
may apply. This guest membership program is limited to first-time visitors.
For the member: complete the information below and
give the card to your invitee. You will be entered into
our drawing for fitness clothing.
Guest:
Maria Zoranski
Member: Rick Armstrong
